item.title: How Sweden built one of Europe’s hottest startup ecosystems
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Sophia Bendz, general partner at Cherry Ventures, stopped by Equity to break down the latest in the Swedish tech ecosystem.

item.title: As electric two-wheelers gain a foothold, Belgian startup Any bets on cargo space
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Launched by Belgian startup Any, LUV1 is a modular electric motorcycle with 120 liters of cargo space that can be used to carry bags, work equipment, or even pets.

item.title: AI, athletes, and Keith Rabois: StrictlyVC is back in New York on September 10
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: A boutique StrictlyVC evening returns to New York's West Village on September 10 with Keith Rabois, Craig Shapiro, Jason Levien, Tristan Walker, Brynn Putnam, and Deven Parekh — covering AI, sports investing, community-building, venture economics, and politics, with cocktails, food, and networking throughout the night.

item.title: Fashion startup Atorie raises $9.5M to bring consumers luxury goods without the markup
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Shoppers can visit the Atorie website and buy handbags or clothes made from the same material — and coming from the same factory — that manufacturers use in high-end goods.

item.title: Hoomanely’s building a smart feeding bowl and an AI platform to help owners spot when their pup is sick
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Hoomanely has developed a smart bowl to measure and record dogs' feeding data, then tells owners if behaviors change.

item.title: This former PG&E engineer is building a ‘Google Maps for the underground’
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The startup just raised a $26 million Series A to grow its customer base and help reduce red tape for utility and construction work.

item.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.

item.title: Flipboard acquires Graze, the feed builder working to monetize the open social web
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Flipboard is acquiring Bluesky feed-building startup Graze, bringing its privacy-friendly ad technology and creator monetization tools into Flipboard’s growing open social web ecosystem.

item.title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Particle’s new podcast intelligence platform transcribes and analyzes more than 130,000 podcasts, making their conversations searchable on the web and accessible to AI agents through an API and MCP.

item.title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The glasses, called Legato Frames, integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames.

item.title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Runable says 60% to 70% of its 1 trillion-plus token usage in the last 90 days came from paying customers.

item.title: Your vote matters! Decide which Audience Choice sessions will make it to TechCrunch Founder Summit
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Each year, we get a huge influx of applicants to speak at TechCrunch’s events, and this year’s Founder Summit in Boston on November 4 will be no different!

item.title: Tonight marks your last chance to save up to $300 on a TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

item.title: Self-driving truck startup Gatik raises $200M following PepsiCo deal
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The funding, Gatik's largest so far, was led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies.

item.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Now exiting stealth mode with a $26 million seed round, Keenable has been building a vast web search index for AI agents.

item.title: Andy Dunn’s startup Pie becomes less of an events app and more of a social network
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The social app founded by Bonobos co-founder Andy Dunn is expanding beyond events with new digital homes for groups to connect, organize, and make plans.

item.title: Fitbit founders launch Luffu Link, an LTE health and safety band
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Luffu Link combines all-day health sensing, voice logging, location awareness, and the ability to get help from trusted contacts into a single device, all without needing a phone nearby.

item.title: India’s Airbound bags $37M to take on trucks with rocket-like drones
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Airbound's ultra-lightweight approach to drone delivery has attracted backing from Greenoaks, DoorDash, and Silicon Valley investor Lachy Groom.

item.title: Showcase your startup at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and book an exhibit table while there’s still space
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Make the most of Disrupt's crowds of potential investors and partners by exhibiting your startup from October 13-15.
